test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

We had repaired the roads before the monsoon set in.

options.text: The roads were repaired before the monsoon set in.
The roads had been repaired before the monsoon set in.
The roads have been repaired before the monsoon set in.
The roads are repaired before the monsoon set in.

solution:
The correct answer is O**ption 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the **past perfect tense**, which is used to describe an action that was completed before another past action.
 
• In the passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The correct structure for past perfect tense in passive voice is: ***subject + had been + past participle + (by agent)*.**

Therefore, the correct passive form is "**The roads had been repaired before the monsoon set in."**
